title: Budget-clock B4a: root_fixture (src/tests/engram_root_dispatch.rs) selects the scripted clock, with an audit of its root_dispatch callers, so the 1 s real bind backoff no longer races queued admission under load
outcome: root_fixture chooses the scripted budget clock through the slice-1 boundary before Engram is enabled. Every test that calls root_fixture is audited for its deadline, backoff, elapsed and wait sources: it either advances the scripted clock across its causal boundary, with a positive control, or declares Real with a reason. held_child_initial_and_followup_authorization_survive_polling_then_resume then passes even with an injected delay longer than 1 s between the child's eager bind and its admission, and its about-24 s unloaded runtime is explained or reduced. No production change, no weakened expectation.
acceptance: A controlled delayed-admission diagnostic, without machine load, first fails the unchanged held_child_initial_and_followup_authorization_survive_polling_then_resume at src/tests/engram_post_receipt.rs:1501 with "bind, followup=false" (Active, expected Idle). It does so by holding the child's queued admission more than 1 s of real time after its eager bind's lost reply. The original failed gate run test-3786f725-1837-4bc0-92e8-8a29ce552b28 is retained.

root_fixture selects the state's scripted budget clock through the slice-1 boundary (select_test_scripted_engram_budget_clock) before Engram is enabled and before any target or worker snapshot. A note lists every root_fixture caller with its deadline, backoff, elapsed and wait sources and its assertions. Each caller either advances that same clock across its causal boundary, with a positive control that shows the unexpired side, or declares Real with a stated reason.

A retained test-only stall of more than 1 s of real time, between the child's eager bind and its queued admission, leaves held_child_… passing on the scripted clock: the child stays Idle and its prompt stays queued. The test's existing assertions are unchanged.
A note explains held_child_…'s roughly 24 s unloaded runtime from measured sources. Any real-time wait that isn't the subject of its test is removed or moved onto the scripted clock.

Production code changes only by a cfg(test) seam, if one is needed. No production timeout, default, backoff or expiry changes. No retry is added, no expectation is weakened, and no test timeout grows.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary: root_fixture runs on the state's scripted Engram budget clock, chosen before Engram is enabled. Every root_fixture caller is audited (126 tests): tests that cross the bind backoff advance that same clock, with a pending-side positive control, through elapse_bind_backoff and arm_bind_backoff; one control declares Real. A cfg(test) admission stall witnesses that a late-scheduled child stays held. Landed as master 1b2d8a0.
